name: clinpub
description: End-to-end clinical data analysis and publication pipeline that adapts to any clinical research article type. Reads CSV/XLSX data, runs R-based statistical analysis, generates publication-grade figures, searches literature (PubMed), writes IMRAD manuscripts, and supports post-writing improvement, cover-letter generation, and post-submission reviewer response.

interface.longDescription: ClinPub is a structured clinical data analysis and publication pipeline that acts as a senior medical statistician and academic writing consultant. Core pipeline Phase 0-3: project initialization/import, data cleaning, adaptive statistical analysis, and IMRAD manuscript writing. Standalone tools cover manuscript improvement, cover-letter generation, and post-submission reviewer response. Adapts to any clinical research article type.
interface.shortDescription: End-to-end clinical data analysis and publication pipeline for any clinical research article type.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me analyze clinical data and write a publication.
